name: create: agent then human review
prompt: Review invoices with a human approver
responses:
version: abada.io/v1
metadata:
  key: {{KEY}}
  name: {{NAME}}
flow:
  entry: start
  nodes:
    - id: start
      type: webhook
      next: extract
    - id: extract
      type: agent
      model: gemini-3.6-flash
      prompt: Extract the invoice fields
      result_variable: invoice
      next: review
    - id: review
      type: human-input
      assignees: [finance]
      next: done
    - id: done
      type: end

name: create: deterministic routing with a condition
responses:
version: abada.io/v1
metadata:
  key: {{KEY}}
  name: {{NAME}}
flow:
  entry: start
  nodes:
    - id: start
      type: webhook
      next: route
    - id: route
      type: condition
      rules:
        - if: amount > 1000
          then: manual
        - else: true
          then: auto
    - id: manual
      type: human-input
      assignees: [sales]
      next: done
    - id: auto
      type: engine-task
      service: orders.fulfil
      next: done
    - id: done
      type: end

name: create: decision table before an agent
prompt: Score candidates then draft a reply
responses:
version: abada.io/v1
metadata:
  key: {{KEY}}
  name: {{NAME}}
flow:
  entry: start
  nodes:
    - id: start
      type: webhook
      next: score
    - id: score
      type: decision-table
      decisionKey: CANDIDATE_SCORE
      hitPolicy: FIRST
      inputs:
        - name: score
      rules:
        - when: score >= 75
          then:
            rating: pass
        - otherwise: true
          then:
            rating: fail
      next: reply
    - id: reply
      type: agent
      model: gemini-3.6-flash
      prompt: Draft a reply for a candidate rated ${rating}
      next: done
    - id: done
      type: end

name: create: a wait with a timer
responses:
version: abada.io/v1
metadata:
  key: {{KEY}}
  name: {{NAME}}
flow:
  entry: start
  nodes:
    - id: start
      type: webhook
      next: wait
    - id: wait
      type: timer
      duration: P1D
      next: remind
    - id: remind
      type: engine-task
      service: notify.remind
      next: done
    - id: done
      type: end

name: create: agent with an output contract and review boundary
prompt: Classify leads and review the unsure ones
responses:
version: abada.io/v1
metadata:
  key: {{KEY}}
  name: {{NAME}}
flow:
  entry: start
  nodes:
    - id: start
      type: webhook
      next: classify
    - id: classify
      type: agent
      model: gemini-3.6-flash
      prompt: Classify the lead
      result_variable: lead
      output_schema:
        type: object
        required: [priority]
        properties:
          priority:
            enum: [HIGH, LOW]
      confidence_threshold: 80
      on_low_confidence: review
      next: done
    - id: review
      type: human-input
      assignees: [sales]
      next: done
    - id: done
      type: end

name: refine: add a fraud check before approval
prompt: Add a fraud check agent before the approval
base:
version: abada.io/v1

  name: Claims
flow:

  nodes:
    - id: start
      type: webhook
      next: triage
    - id: triage
      type: agent
      model: gemini-3.6-flash
      prompt: Assess the claim
      result_variable: assessment
      next: approve
    - id: approve
      type: human-input
      assignees: [claims-team]
      next: done
    - id: done
      type: end
